name: @corbits-builder/design-app
description: Designs how the app could look, as mockups the person compares and chooses from.
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.when: The person wants to see how the app could look: a mockup, design options to compare, or another pass on a design option.
builder.unless: They want the built app itself changed, or to pick fonts or colours on a screen.

design.when: The person wants to see how the app could look: a mockup, design options to compare, or another pass on a design option.
design.unless: They want the built app itself changed, or to pick fonts or colours on a screen.

examples: make me a mockup for a dog-walking app
show me a few different looks
can I see what it would look like

facts.design_chosen: the person chose a design from the design options
